standard: Maintained experiments must make design provenance, bounded acceptance criteria, outcome, reproducibility, and exact revision-bound evidence explicit.

entries.question: Can Overcenter claim real work and deliver a self-contained byte-complete assignment to an empty disposable worker?
entries.claim: For the bounded proof workload, the claimed Work snapshot plus exact task bytes is sufficient for a no-checkout, no-network worker to produce candidate output that trusted authority can independently settle.
entries.contrast: Assign exact identity but require the worker to obtain source/input bytes through an ambient checkout or mount.
environment: Node.js from .node-version for the deterministic contract.
GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 for the no-checkout worker and isolated network namespace.
success_criteria: A production SQLite kernel derives READY work and claims it at an exact revision.
The worker receives the claimed Work snapshot and all task-specific bytes in one immutable capsule.
The worker executes with no checkout, repository permission, execution capability, or outbound network namespace.
Missing or altered required bytes fail closed before execution.
Candidate bytes bind to the exact assignment digest, obligation, run, and claimed revision.
Trusted reconstruction and independent observation settle the same run DONE.

artifacts: GitHub Actions run 35488740731: exact-head hosted assignment capsule proof; deterministic contract, no-checkout worker, isolated network namespace, damaged-assignment controls, and trusted settlement all passed.

entries.interpretation: A positive result proves byte-complete assignment plumbing for the bounded workload; it does not make the worker authoritative for success or imply arbitrary toolchain portability.
non_claims: The Node runtime or Linux kernel are embedded in the assignment.
This is a general artifact distribution or confidential payload service.
Arbitrary provider mutation is authorized by the worker capsule.
Every future obligation already fits this proof packet.

design.note: The boundary and fail-closed criteria were committed on the experiment branch before the hosted proof result; later exact-head runs confirm the same bounded contract.

outcome.summary: Exact claimed work and task bytes were delivered to a no-checkout, no-network worker and independently settled by trusted authority.

entries.question: Can Overcenter delegate implementation judgment to a disposable Codex worker while retaining claim, verification, settlement, publication, and readback authority outside the worker?
entries.claim: For the bounded witness, an exact claimed obligation can pass through an untrusted Codex implementation step and become an independently verified, settled, exact-byte draft PR without granting the worker publication authority.
entries.contrast: Let the reasoning worker hold repository write credentials, publish its own patch, or declare its own success.
environment: Node.js from .node-version for the deterministic contract and Overcenter authority steps.
GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 for the hosted transaction.
OPENAI_API_KEY GitHub Actions secret.
openai/codex-action pinned to 86365089eb2b84e0a8fb0717b304f8bdcb13b20e.
success_criteria: Overcenter derives and claims the witness obligation before the reasoning worker runs.
The Codex job has repository read permission only, no persisted checkout credential, and cannot write Git metadata.
Candidate bytes are confined to the declared path and bound to the exact assignment digest and claimed run.
Trusted reconstruction independently verifies the postcondition and settles the original run DONE.
Only a separate trusted publisher receives repository and pull-request write authority.
GitHub readback reports the exact trusted-publisher commit on the expected base as an open draft PR.

artifacts: .github/workflows/codex-closed-loop.yml
evidence.pending_reason: The deterministic boundary is implemented, but accepted hosted Codex execution evidence under the maintained integration path has not yet been recorded.

entries.interpretation: A positive result establishes the bounded reasoning-worker transaction boundary. It supports using Codex as a disposable implementation worker, not as authority for project truth or provider mutation.
non_claims: Arbitrary code changes are independently verifiable with this one-file witness policy.
Ambiguous GitHub mutation outcomes are recovered automatically.
The worker is trusted because the candidate passed.
GitHub itself is authoritative project state.
The witness pull request should be merged.

design.note: The worker/trusted-authority boundary and acceptance criteria are recorded while the hosted closed-loop outcome remains pending.

outcome.summary: The deterministic contract is maintained, but the hosted reasoning-worker transaction has not yet produced accepted evidence under the current integration boundary.

entries.question: Can a fresh worker recover after the original worker disappears?
entries.claim: Exact durable authority is sufficient for fresh-worker reconstruction and settlement.
environment: Node.js from .node-version and Git for the deterministic handoff proof.
GitHub Actions for the hosted worker-destruction/provider-readback proof with job-level permission separation.
success_criteria: After the original worker sandbox is destroyed, a fresh worker reconstructs the unresolved run from durable authority without using the original checkout, cache, database, refs, or process memory.
Recovery rotates execution authority so stale execution generation cannot continue acting for the run.
Verifier or obligation replacement is rejected rather than being accepted as recovery of the original claim.
Lost settlement acknowledgement is reconciled without producing a second semantic result.
Missing or ambiguous authority fails closed, and competing authority updates preserve a single CAS winner.
The hosted path settles from independent GitHub readback through the production status-effect boundary rather than trusting the original worker's success assertion.

artifacts: GitHub Actions run 35463403293

entries.interpretation: The experiment demonstrates that run identity and recovery state can survive total worker loss when authority, execution generation, reservation, and receipt identity are durable and independently reconstructible.
non_claims: Every execution substrate physically separates worker and provider credentials.
GitHub repository-scoped statuses:write is coordinate-scoped least privilege.
Fresh recovery is guaranteed to regain liveness.
Worker disposability makes worker assertions authoritative for settlement.

design.note: The original experiment had produced results before the repository-wide experiment contract was introduced. The maintained criteria document the bounded evidence and are not represented as preregistered.

outcome.summary: A fresh worker can reconstruct and settle the same unresolved run from durable authority after the original worker disappears.

entries.question: Can a worker receive exactly declared GitHub bytes without a checkout or repository credential?
entries.claim: Manifest-bound bytes plus permission-separated publication make task scope and result readback independently checkable.
entries.contrast: Give the worker a normal checkout and trust path discipline.
environment: Node.js from .node-version for the deterministic manifest/path contract.
GitHub Actions for permission-separated materialization, no-checkout execution, trusted publication, and authoritative readback.
success_criteria: The deterministic contract accepts only declared GitHub object inputs and bounded writable paths represented by the manifest.
The disposable worker operates from materialized declared blobs without a repository checkout or repository credential.
The worker validates the realized workspace against the same exact manifest bytes it received as read-only input.
Only the trusted publication stage receives repository write authority and publishes the authorized candidate bytes.
Authoritative GitHub readback confirms the published result independently of the worker's local claim.

artifacts: GitHub Actions run 35465653729: materialize, no-checkout execute, publish, and authoritative readback all passed.

entries.interpretation: The hosted proof makes task input identity, writable scope, publication authority, and result readback independently checkable without giving the disposable worker a normal credentialed checkout.
non_claims: The transport is an arbitrary filesystem sandbox.
GitHub provides provider-native coordinate-scoped authorization for the worker.
The manifest proves arbitrary task closure or toolchain completeness.
A worker's candidate output becomes project truth without trusted publication and readback.

design.note: The original experiment had produced results before the repository-wide experiment contract was introduced. The maintained criteria document the bounded evidence and are not represented as preregistered.

outcome.summary: Manifest-bound bytes, no-checkout execution, permission-separated publication, and independent readback make the bounded worker transport independently checkable.

entries.question: Can Overcenter maintain a reproducible total ordering of production-code importance from quantitative facts?
entries.claim: A revision-bound callable graph plus explicit authority/recovery semantics can derive an inspectable production-code criticality vector and a calibrated total order without ranking tests or experiments themselves.
entries.contrast: Periodically repeat a human ranking exercise or rely on generic complexity/hotspot metrics alone.
environment: Node.js from .node-version
Git with full repository history for revision-bound blame/change exposure
TypeScript 5.8.3 installed for the analyzer
success_criteria: Only production callables under src/ enter the ranked population.
Configured authority and recovery selectors resolve exactly once.
Internal static-call resolution remains informative; unresolved internal/unknown calls are reported, and critical callback-boundary exemptions fail closed when stale or malformed.
Every named required calibration regression remains satisfied while known model mismatches remain explicit diagnostics rather than consuming a percentage budget.
Every surprising rank decomposes into quantitative vector components and graph evidence.
Deleting generated reports and recomputing at the same revision produces the same result.

artifacts: GitHub Actions run 35673456200: production criticality ranking passed after component-local normalization made unchanged authority components invariant to disconnected production code.
experiments/production-criticality-ranking/mutation-evidence.json: exact-blob-bound hostile-case evidence; stale probes fail closed to a full evidence gap.

entries.interpretation: The maintained ranking provides reproducible consequence and engineering-attention orders from revision-bound graph and evidence facts. Component-local normalization prevents unrelated disconnected code from perturbing unchanged authority components. Required calibration regressions remain explicit, branch-level/callable-granularity mismatches remain diagnostics, and mutation evidence is exact-blob-bound so stale probes fail closed rather than silently transferring.
non_claims: Callable boundaries are the final semantic unit.
Static test reachability is equivalent to hostile-case evidence.
Exported-entrypoint reachability is equivalent to production telemetry.
The current weighting equation is uniquely correct.

design.note: Prior human pairwise judgments predate the analyzer, but callable granularity, ranking policy, component normalization, and mutation-evidence handling evolved in response to observed disagreements and gaps.

outcome.summary: The ranking is reproducible and useful for consequence/attention ordering, while callable granularity and hostile-case evidence remain explicit model limitations rather than hidden calibration errors.

entries.question: For one successful production GitHub status transaction, how much latency belongs to Overcenter local correctness machinery versus provider I/O?
entries.claim: The benchmark separates SQLite authority, reservation, provider identity, the mutation boundary, readback, and local settlement costs while exercising the unchanged production GitHub status effect.
entries.contrast: Infer feasibility from whole GitHub Actions job duration or storage microbenchmarks without timing the production transaction boundary.
environment: Node.js from .node-version.
Local mode uses SQLite plus an in-memory fake GitHub transport.
Hosted live mode uses GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 and the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN with statuses: write.
success_criteria: Every sample claims exact SQLite-backed work and settles DONE from authoritative readback.
Experiment-only timing wraps the production effect boundary without changing production mutation code.
Provider-facing I/O and local Overcenter work are reported separately.

artifacts: GitHub Actions run 35540143115: 25-sample deterministic baseline and 3-sample live GitHub decomposition passed with production source unchanged.
experiments/production-latency/results/2026-09-20.md

entries.interpretation: Use the result as a single-operation latency decomposition. Compare provider and Overcenter-local cost; do not extrapolate it directly to concurrency or large-history throughput.
non_claims: Large-history projection remains constant-time.
SQLite is a distributed or HA authority store.
GitHub rate limits permit arbitrary transaction throughput.
Recovery-path latency matches successful-path latency.
Other providers have the same latency profile.

design.note: The transaction boundary and timing buckets were fixed for the hosted measurement, while the numeric latency result is observational rather than a preregistered performance threshold.

outcome.summary: The benchmark separates Overcenter-local correctness work from provider-facing latency for the bounded successful GitHub status transaction.

analysis.estimand: Observed successful single-transaction latency decomposition on the exact hosted GitHub treatment.

uncertainty.reason: The evaluated live result contains only three samples and is intentionally descriptive rather than a population latency estimate.

analysis.stopping_rule: The historical evaluated treatment used exactly three live GitHub samples.

entries.question: Can a small static abstract interpreter reject mutation paths where untrusted agent data, exact revision identity, or current execution authority cross a trust boundary incorrectly, while accepting the real GitHub mutation paths without per-path suppressions?
entries.claim: A product abstract domain over untrusted origin, candidate validation, exact revision, current lease, possible call targets, and mutation-admitted control can reject the preregistered hostile authority-flow mutants while accepting both admitted GitHub mutation paths with zero suppressions.
entries.contrast: Rely on TypeScript types and local runtime validators without whole-path analysis across serialization, queue, aliasing, branch-join, and dynamic-dispatch boundaries.
environment: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 with Node.js from .node-version.
Repository-pinned TypeScript 7.0.2 dev toolchain installed only in the hosted build environment.
TypeScript 7 unstable/sync and unstable/ast APIs parse source without executing the analyzed program.
No provider credential, database, model, or external service is required by the analysis itself.
success_criteria: All 16 hostile mutants are rejected for their expected authority-flow violation: 12 preregistered flow mutants, 3 preregistered production-boundary mutants, and 1 post-observation conditional-dominance mutant.
All 4 safe controls are accepted without diagnostics.
Both current GitHub mutation provider paths are accepted.
Production acceptance requires zero suppressions or per-path allowlists.
The analysis is static: analyzed snippets and production provider code are parsed but never executed.
The analyzer remains build-time tooling only: production and self-application retain zero npm runtime dependencies.

artifacts: experiments/authority-flow-analysis/experiment.ts
experiments/authority-flow-analysis/analyzer.ts
GitHub Actions run 35920287943, job 107382200565: exact-head checkout and static authority-flow differential PASS.
Hosted result: 16/16 hostile mutants rejected, 4/4 safe controls accepted, both production GitHub mutation paths accepted, and production suppressions = 0.
Merge-gate run 35920288403, exact-head rerun job 107384147704: candidate merge certification PASS on the same treatment revision.

entries.interpretation: A positive result would justify a production linter that makes runtime-established authority and deliberate proof decay visible across program boundaries; a false positive on current production or false negative in the hostile corpus would reject this abstraction.
non_claims: The prototype is sound for arbitrary TypeScript or JavaScript.
Runtime authority, revision, lifecycle, unresolved-effect, or provider checks can be removed.
All dynamic dispatch forms are covered.
Serialization is inherently unsafe rather than a boundary requiring proof reconstruction.
Provider credentials become least-privilege.
Malicious trusted code or explicit analyzer bypasses are prevented.

design.note: The abstract domain, 12 flow mutants, 3 original production-boundary mutants, safe controls, production no-suppression criterion, and falsification rule were fixed before the first candidate run. That run exposed that classifying the TypeScript-API experiment as deterministic leaked a dev-tool dependency into dependency-free self-application; the hosted/tooling isolation criterion was added afterward without changing the original corpus. Later exact-head review identified a conditional-beginEffect dominance false negative; a fourth production-boundary mutant was added explicitly post-observation and the checker was narrowed to require an unconditional top-level beginEffect call before any effect invocation.

outcome.summary: At exact revision 7554f069570e6501afc971adfb9d7420dae3b683, the hosted checker rejected all 16 hostile mutants, accepted all 4 safe controls and both real GitHub mutation paths, and required zero production suppressions. The result supports the bounded build-time sidecar claim, not a universal TypeScript soundness claim or production authority role.

entries.question: Can independent disposable controllers share authoritative Overcenter project truth without a shared application database by using immutable Git facts plus one remote exact-head CAS coordinate?
entries.claim: For the bounded GitHub-hosted treatment, fresh controllers with no shared local database can race on one exact READY revision, produce exactly one winning claim, survive winner and effect-broker termination, reconstruct an unresolved GitHub status reservation from remote authority, block duplicate mutation, settle from fresh provider observation, reject stale authority, and fail closed when the remote authority service is unavailable.
entries.contrast: Require a shared SQL authority database or allow a healthy local controller copy to become authoritative when the remote authority coordinate is unavailable.
environment: Node.js from .node-version and the production GitOvercenterKernel/GitFactStore.
The local contract uses separate local Git repositories over one bare remote and a shared file only as the local observation fixture.
The hosted treatment uses separate GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 jobs, one ephemeral remote Git authority ref, and no shared application database between jobs.
The hosted effect is the production GitHub commit-status mutation path using a unique status context on the exact source SHA.
GitHub Actions provides contents:write for the ephemeral authority ref and statuses:write for the bounded provider effect.
success_criteria: Two separate hosted contender jobs begin from the same preregistered READY revision and exactly one claim becomes authoritative.
A fresh controller reconstructs the winning run from the remote authority ref after both contender jobs terminate.
A different fresh controller rotates execution authority, durably reserves the production GitHub status effect, performs the status mutation, and terminates without settlement.
Another fresh controller reconstructs the unresolved reservation and a second effect attempt is rejected with UNRESOLVED_EFFECT before provider mutation.
The recovery controller records termination/recovery evidence, independently observes the GitHub status, and settles the same run DONE without replay.
The final authority history contains exactly one claim and one effect reservation for the obligation.
A controller using the original stale READY revision is rejected rather than creating a new claim or settlement.

After a fresh controller has fetched a valid local copy of authority, making the remote authority endpoint unreachable causes authority reads to fail closed with AUTHORITY_UNREACHABLE rather than promoting the local copy.
The local deterministic contract reproduces the single-winner, handoff, unresolved-effect, settlement, stale-revision, and authority-unreachable invariants without provider credentials.

artifacts: GitHub Actions run 35924683116: exact-head distributed authority handoff proof PASS across setup, two contender runners, fresh effect broker, fresh recovery controller, stale/unreachable controls, and cleanup.
Contender A won run b4725576-69ee-440e-98ff-c72220ed482c at claim commit 6a9fbb21e4e5fcea7c40b68d4cb081ee308d5922; contender B lost with CLAIM_LOST.
Fresh broker execution generation 2 created exactly one reservation and performed GitHub status context overcenter/ha-proof/35924683116/1; authority head ac4082d8b73c3641a99ad98bcf2cd861096c8d35.

Fresh recovery execution generation 3 blocked duplicate beginEffect, settled the same run DONE from GitHub readback, retained one claim and one reservation, and advanced authority to 90241850b7258dda7578354fed17ab89c70f48e6.
Fresh control runner rejected the original READY revision and failed closed when the remote authority endpoint was made unreachable while a valid local authority ref remained present.

The first hosted attempt exposed a local-fixture indirection bug and the second exposed a missing User-Agent in the production GitHub status transport; both were repaired without changing the preregistered authority acceptance criteria.

entries.interpretation: The bounded result supports the narrow architectural claim that shared application SQL is not required for this multi-controller failover path: immutable portable authority facts plus a linearizable remote head transition were sufficient. The experiment also surfaced and repaired a real live-path HTTP transport defect (missing User-Agent) before the provider effect could participate in the handoff. This does not establish an HA SLA or make Git the preferred production hot path.
non_claims: GitHub provides an availability or latency SLA suitable for every Overcenter deployment.
The Git reference backend belongs on the production hot path at arbitrary scale.
Distributed authority is consensus-free; the remote exact-head transition still embodies an agreement primitive.
The experiment proves multi-region partition tolerance, Byzantine fault tolerance, or quorum durability.
Every provider mutation can be recovered from the same observation semantics as GitHub commit status.
A controller may continue mutating project truth while the remote authority service is unavailable.

design.note: The single-winner race, controller-death handoffs, unresolved-effect replay prohibition, stale-revision control, remote-unavailable control, and exact hosted topology were recorded before the first hosted execution.

outcome.summary: At exact revision 06cb8d5a27f92aa40e37c307d3da2f8f53c61e80, independent hosted controllers sharing no application database produced one exact-head claim winner, survived controller and effect-broker handoff, reconstructed one unresolved external-effect reservation, blocked replay, settled from fresh provider observation, rejected stale authority, and refused to promote a local copy when remote authority was unavailable.

entries.question: Does the Postgres-free remote-CAS authority architecture survive repeated controller turnover, concurrent unrelated authority updates, unresolved-effect handoff, and repeated execution-authority rotation rather than only one staged transaction?
entries.claim: For 48 independent obligations and eight logical controllers, three fresh hosted controller waves plus a fresh bounded sweeper can preserve exactly one claim per obligation, at most one effect reservation per run, recover controller deaths after claim and reservation, survive a second controller death immediately after authority rotation, and eventually settle every obligation DONE without any shared application database.
entries.contrast: Treat the successful single handoff as sufficient HA evidence, or require controller-local database continuity for progress after repeated failures.
environment: Node.js from .node-version and the production GitOvercenterKernel/GitFactStore.
The deterministic contract uses fresh local Git repositories for each logical controller wave over one bare remote authority ref.
The hosted treatment uses eight logical controllers across three GitHub Actions matrix waves; every wave receives a fresh hosted checkout and shares only the remote authority ref.

Forty-eight independent obligations use a stable local-file observation fixture so this experiment isolates authority/recovery endurance rather than repeating the live provider-mutation claim already established by distributed-authority-handoff.
A final fresh controller performs a bounded sweep only after all injected-failure waves have terminated.
success_criteria: All 48 obligations end DONE after three eight-controller waves and one fresh bounded sweeper.
Every obligation has exactly one durable ClaimFact despite concurrent unrelated authority updates and controller restarts.
No run has more than one EffectReservationFact.
The preregistered reservation-crash controls for chaos-0003 and chaos-0005 each retain exactly one reservation through fresh-controller recovery.
chaos-0002 and chaos-0003 settle at execution generation at least 2, demonstrating takeover after controller termination following claim or reservation.
chaos-0004 and chaos-0005 settle at execution generation at least 3, demonstrating another controller can die immediately after authority rotation and a later fresh controller can take over again.
Recovery of an unresolved reservation verifies that beginEffect remains rejected with UNRESOLVED_EFFECT before settlement.

The final sweeper reaches all-DONE within 256 authority transitions under the explicit assumptions that remote authority remains available, the observation fixture remains stable, and fresh controllers keep taking steps.
The local deterministic contract reproduces the same six failure modes with a fresh local repository for every logical controller wave.

artifacts: GitHub Actions run 35930448775: exact-head distributed authority chaos treatment PASS across deterministic preflight, 24 hosted controller-wave jobs, fresh bounded sweep, durable verifier, and cleanup.
Final verifier: 48 obligations DONE, 48 ClaimFacts, 24 EffectReservationFacts, with exactly one claim per obligation and no duplicate reservation per run.
chaos-0002 settled at execution generation 2; chaos-0003 settled at generation 2 with its reservation retained through recovery.

chaos-0004 and chaos-0005 each forced a generation-2 controller termination after authority rotation and later settled at execution generation 3; chaos-0005 retained its unresolved reservation and blocked replay.
Fresh sweeper reached all-DONE in 34 successful authority transitions versus the preregistered maximum of 256.
Standing exact-head Merge gate, Typed capability authority, Authority flow analysis, Effect authority decay, and Distributed authority handoff workflows all passed at the treatment revision.

entries.interpretation: The bounded result strengthens the single distributed-authority handoff into repeated controller-turnover evidence: controller-local database continuity was unnecessary across 24 hosted fault-injection jobs, while one remote exact-head authority coordinate preserved safety and allowed conditional progress. The 34-transition sweep is also evidence that the remaining work was recoverable rather than merely fail-closed. This still does not establish an HA SLA, provider-general mutation recovery, or starvation freedom.
non_claims: This experiment re-proves arbitrary external-provider mutation recovery; it intentionally uses a stable local observation fixture.
The scheduler is starvation-free under arbitrary adversarial scheduling.
GitHub provides a production availability, latency, or durability SLA appropriate for every deployment.
The architecture is consensus-free; the remote exact-head transition remains the agreement primitive.
The experiment proves multi-region partitions, Byzantine faults, or unbounded liveness.
Forty-eight obligations and three waves establish asymptotic scalability.

design.note: The 48-obligation hosted population, eight-controller ownership partition, three fresh-runner waves, six fault modes, generation thresholds, single-claim/single-reservation invariants, and 256-transition sweep bound were recorded before the first hosted execution. Developmental runs exposed only formatter and local-preflight cost issues; the local preflight was reduced to one obligation per fault mode without changing the hosted 48-obligation treatment or acceptance criteria.

outcome.summary: At exact revision 1d496629374cf83802680fe6ba33a35b9d17d8dc, 48 obligations survived three waves of eight fresh hosted controllers with deterministic claim, reservation, and post-rotation termination modes. Every obligation retained exactly one claim, every run at most one reservation, generation-2 and generation-3 takeover controls passed, and a fresh sweeper closed the project DONE in 34 of the allowed 256 transitions.

entries.question: Can signed, context-bound substrate capability evidence safely affect admission for one exact provider capability without trusting environment declarations?
entries.claim: For github.commit-status.write, authenticated context-bound evidence can safely admit controlled isolation and reject ambient authority, while a point observation of absence remains informational and non-authorizing.
entries.contrast: Trust self-described substrate capabilities or unsigned/stale observations as sufficient admission evidence.
environment: Node.js from .node-version for the deterministic evidence-boundary model.
GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 for exact-revision capability probes.
Fixture A runs the production Rust confinement proof; B probes github.commit-status.write with contents:read only; C probes the same capability with statuses:write.
Ephemeral Ed25519 keys model separate trusted attestors; admission receives only the corresponding public trust roots.
success_criteria: The preregistered A/B/C admission matrix matches exactly for github.commit-status.write.
Only the controlled sandbox satisfies either an absence-through-execution guarantee or controlled physical isolation.
A foreign substrate with a point-in-time HTTP 403 observation is rejected when an obligation requires absence throughout execution.
The hostile descriptor that claims isolation is rejected when trusted evidence reports the capability present.
Modifying a signed guarantee without the trusted private key is rejected.
An attacker cannot gain trust merely by writing the trusted issuer name into self-signed evidence.
Valid evidence for a different substrate is rejected.
Valid evidence for a different capability is rejected.
Valid evidence from a stale admission epoch is rejected as context-bound data, without claiming the epoch advances automatically when capabilities change.
Valid evidence from a different source revision is rejected.
An unrecognized signed evidence schema is rejected at runtime.
The trusted capability probe cannot assert controlled isolation.
The controlled-substrate attestor cannot assert observational absence.
Ordinary pull-request CI contains no statuses:write job; the positive ambient-write treatment is workflow_dispatch only.

artifacts: GitHub Actions run 35930128165: exact-head pull-request-safe Substrate capability admission workflow passed the deterministic evidence boundary, production Rust controlled-substrate proof, and read-only HTTP 403 point-observation probe; ordinary PR CI had no statuses:write job.

GitHub Actions Merge gate run 35930128402: exact-head candidate and PR preflight passed lint, strict TypeScript type checking, experiment-contract verification, adapter diagnosability checking, and the ordinary deterministic regression suite.

Historical positive treatment run 35926698367: the same github.commit-status.write probe returned HTTP 201 when statuses:write was deliberately granted. The equivalent positive treatment is now isolated behind workflow_dispatch.

entries.interpretation: The bounded result supports authenticated, context-bound capability evidence as an admission representation. Controlled-isolation attestation can authorize confinement-sensitive work and observed ambient authority can reject it. A point observation of absence on a mutable foreign substrate is explicitly non-authorizing for an absence-through-execution requirement.
non_claims: Project-truth isolation is re-proven by this experiment.
A failed request proves all provider-write capabilities are absent.
A point observation of capability absence can authorize an obligation requiring absence throughout execution.
An admission epoch automatically advances when a foreign substrate's real capabilities change.
Observed absence remains true after its observation.
The experiment's ephemeral Ed25519 key custody is the production attestation mechanism.
Every consequential capability can be discovered by probing.
Scheduler integration is justified before exact-head evaluation and review.

design.note: Before final evaluation, the experiment was narrowed so observed absence is non-authorizing; runtime schema rejection and issuer-authority negative controls were added; and the statuses:write treatment was isolated behind workflow_dispatch so ordinary PR CI remains read-only with respect to commit-status mutation. The obligation contract names this requirement absent-through-execution so the stronger temporal guarantee is explicit.

outcome.summary: Authenticated evidence admitted only controlled isolation for confinement-sensitive obligations, rejected observed ambient authority, rejected point-in-time absence as execution authority, and passed forgery, schema, scope, issuer-authority, revision, execution, and epoch-context falsifiers.

entries.question: Can Overcenter factor durable project authority into immutable content-addressed fact objects plus a separately linearizable authority-head CAS without changing project semantics?
entries.claim: For the bounded treatment, semantic fact payloads can live in an independently addressed immutable object store while Git stores only one fact-id pointer per authority revision and supplies exact-head CAS. The composed store preserves the DurableFactStore contract, matches the monolithic Git kernel's logical transitions, fails closed when an authoritative fact object is missing, and admits exactly one winner under an eight-process same-head race even though losing immutable objects remain published but unreachable.
entries.contrast: Keep semantic fact payload and serialization authority inseparable inside one monolithic strongly consistent database or Git history.
environment: Node.js from .node-version.
Production DurableFactStore, KernelCore, runCoreLoop, and monolithic GitOvercenterKernel are used for the differential.
The candidate immutable fact store is a SHA-256 content-addressed directory with idempotent create-only writes.
The candidate authority-head service is a Git ref whose commits contain only one fact-id pointer and whose expected-old-value update-ref operation is the serialization point.
Eight child processes share the immutable object directory and authority repository for the same-head contention treatment.
success_criteria: The composed split store satisfies initialize, append, stale-writer rejection, historical replay, reopen, and current-head behavior equivalent to the DurableFactStore contract.
Every reachable authority-head commit tree contains exactly one file named fact-id and no semantic graph, claim, execution-authority, reservation, release, or receipt payload.
A stale append may leave an immutable content object behind, but that orphan is absent from authoritative history and cannot affect project projection.
Eight processes racing one exact expected head produce exactly one authority winner, one authoritative claim, and seven losing immutable fact objects that remain unreachable.
If a fact object referenced by authoritative head history is removed, replay fails closed with FACT_OBJECT_MISSING rather than silently skipping or reconstructing an empty transition.
A fresh replica of the immutable object directory reconstructs byte-equivalent normalized authoritative history through the same authority-head service.

The split-store KernelCore and the monolithic GitOvercenterKernel derive identical normalized project state, explanations, and receipts before and after a two-obligation production core-loop workload.

artifacts: GitHub Actions run 35939753458, job 107444816800: exact-head authority-storage-decomposition proof PASS.
Durable-store contract: 3 authoritative commits, 4 immutable objects, exactly 1 unreachable stale-writer object, authority tree paths = fact-id only, and fresh object-directory replica replay PASS.
Missing referenced immutable object failed closed with FACT_OBJECT_MISSING while the authority head remained intact.
Kernel differential: split-store KernelCore and monolithic GitOvercenterKernel were logically equivalent before and after the same two-obligation production core-loop workload.
Eight-process same-head race: 8 contenders, exactly 1 winner, 1 authoritative claim, 9 immutable objects total, and 7 unreachable loser objects.
Merge gate run 35939753680 passed lint, typecheck, experiment contracts, adapter diagnosability, and deterministic regression on the same exact revision.

entries.interpretation: The bounded result supports the decomposition itself: immutable semantic fact publication and project-authority serialization need not share one transaction boundary. The authority-head CAS remained the sole operation deciding project truth, while losing content objects were harmless unreachable garbage and missing referenced objects failed closed. This justifies promoting separate ImmutableFactObjects and AuthorityHead interfaces, not the directory-backed experimental implementation.
non_claims: A directory is an appropriate production distributed object store.
The immutable object store requires no durability, replication, integrity, or availability guarantees.
The authority-head service is consensus-free or highly available merely because its state is small.
Git is the preferred production authority-head implementation.
Garbage collection of unreachable fact objects is safe without a separate publication/retention protocol.
The experiment proves multi-region partition tolerance, Byzantine behavior, or an HA SLA.
Backend-local revision identities become portable or byte-identical across authority-head implementations.

design.note: The split responsibilities, semantic differential, head-payload restriction, missing-object negative control, eight-process same-head race, orphan-object expectation, and replica reconstruction criterion were recorded before first execution.

entries.question: Can trusted validation establish authoritative identity for generated artifact bytes that were not known when the obligation was defined, while downstream work consumes only retained evidence and an authoritative settlement receipt?
entries.claim: For the bounded source-proposal model, evidence-first publication plus exact claim binding, trusted scope derivation from artifact bytes, exact-head authority CAS, and settlement-receipt dependency identity is sufficient to represent generated output without trusting a worker-declared digest or predeclaring exact output bytes.
entries.contrast: Treat the worker's declared output identity as authoritative, or append authority before the generated bytes are durably retained.
entries.interpretation: The exact-head treatment supports a narrow verified-generated-output primitive: trusted software may establish post-execution artifact identity from retained bytes, publish that evidence before authority, and let downstream work consume the authoritative settlement receipt. This does not authorize source integration or replace fixed postconditions for ordinary provider effects.
environment: Node.js from .node-version.
Production FileEvidenceStore and EvidenceRef implementation.
One deterministic experimental exact-head authority CAS; no production settlement schema is changed.
Canonical JSON source-proposal artifacts whose changed paths are derived by trusted validation from retained bytes.
No network, provider credential, database, GitHub mutation, LLM, or source integration is required.
success_criteria: A valid generated artifact whose bytes are unknown at definition time is durably published, authority-referenced, read back by EvidenceRef, and yields downstream identity through the authoritative settlement receipt.
Two distinct valid artifact byte sequences under identical claim metadata produce distinct EvidenceRefs, distinct settlement commits, and distinct downstream semantic identities.
Wrong assignment digest, run ID, claimed authority revision, or source revision is rejected before authoritative state changes.
An artifact that writes outside the declared source scope is rejected using paths derived from the artifact bytes rather than worker-declared changed-path metadata.
Evidence publication without authority append leaves authority unchanged and only an orphan immutable object.
Two valid writers from one expected authority head may both publish evidence, but exactly one authority CAS wins and only that settlement determines downstream identity.
Corrupt or missing evidence referenced by an authoritative receipt makes downstream consumption fail closed.
The unsafe worker-declared-output-identity control demonstrates a semantic collision for distinct artifact bytes.
The unsafe authority-first control demonstrates a dangling authoritative reference to unpublished evidence.
non_claims: Arbitrary generated source proposals are semantically correct.
Source integration, merge conflict handling, or Git ref mutation is safe.
Generated outputs should replace fixed postconditions for ordinary provider effects.
The local FileEvidenceStore is a distributed artifact service.
Online garbage collection is safe while evidence publishers are in flight.
A settlement receipt remains usable when its referenced evidence cannot be verified.
A reasoning worker may choose its own claim, source revision, writable scope, verifier, or settlement identity.
Source proposal and source integration must be exposed as two user-visible graph nodes.

entries.question: Does marginal trusted semantic complexity converge as the work Overcenter governs becomes more semantically complex?
entries.claim: Bounded support. Across six preregistered task families, trusted semantic LOC rises from 9,281 to 9,285 at source integration and then plateaus; the more semantic behavioral, migration, and design rungs remain mechanically governable only by narrowing the authoritative claim and retaining residual judgment explicitly.
entries.contrast: Allow trusted verification to grow into a deterministic shadow of the reasoning worker while continuing to describe the trusted kernel as semantically small.

entries.interpretation: The complete six-rung ladder supports a bounded result. Trusted source lines plateau at 9,285 after source integration, and no exercised rung requires task-specific marginal trusted semantics. The consequential provider rung still adds provider-specific scopes and assumptions, while behavioral repair, migration, and architectural design are frontier-limited rather than convergent: exact evidence can be bound mechanically, but universal semantic correctness, equivalence, and design sufficiency remain explicit judgment. This supports reusable authority mechanics inside the mechanically witnessable region without establishing general semantic convergence beyond it. A follow-on explicit judgment-attestation stress test then added 383 reusable trusted semantic LOC without task-specific growth while leaving all pre-existing accepted scopes flat. This falsifies the stronger interpretation that the six-rung plateau means future semantic facts are free, while supporting isolation of new verification primitives from candidate-generating judgment.
non_claims: Synthetic fixtures demonstrate that Overcenter's trusted semantic complexity has converged.
Raw LOC is a sufficient proxy for semantic trust.
A large reusable proof checker is semantic mirroring merely because it is large.
Human or agent judgment becomes objective truth when its exact attestation is mechanically verified.
